from glom import glom, T, S, Path, Spec

# Test dynamic key generation with Spec in dict keys
target = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
spec = {Path('a'): 'x', Path('b'): 'y'}
result = glom(target, spec)
print('Dynamic key with Path:', result)

# Test with T
spec2 = {T['a']: 'x'}
result2 = glom(target, spec2)
print('Dynamic key with T:', result2)
"
